assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: The mass spectrometer was used in a data-dependent mode, which automatically switched between MS and MS/MS.
After a survey scan from 350-1500 m/z the 10 most abundant peptides were subjected to HCD fragmentation.
labeling: no mention of TMT, SILAC, or other tags in the MS section
enrichment: GFP-TRIM46, 480AnkG-GFP and 480AnkG-NN-GFP proteins were purified using Strep(II)-Strep-Tactin affinity purification.

workflow_hints: After in-gel digestion, samples were resuspended in 10% formic acid (FA)/5% DMSO and analyzed with an Agilent 1290 Infinity (Agilent Technologies, CA) LC, operating in reverse-phase (C18) mode, coupled to an Orbitrap Q-Exactive mass spectrometer

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a standard AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using Strep-Tactin beads to purify tagged proteins (TRIM46, AnkG), followed by in-gel digestion and DDA-MS/MS. Quantification was performed via spectrum counting.

scope: GFP-TRIM46, 480AnkG-GFP and 480AnkG-NN-GFP proteins were purified using Strep(II)-Strep-Tactin affinity purification.
The supernatant obtained from the previous step was incubated with Strep-Tactin Sepharose beads (GE) for 45 minutes.
After streptavidin purification, beads were resuspended in 20 µL of Laemmli Sample buffer (Biorad) and supernatants were loaded on a 4-12% gradient Criterion XT Bis-Tris precast gel (Biorad).
After in-gel digestion, samples were resuspended in 10% formic acid (FA)/5% DMSO and analyzed with an Agilent 1290 Infinity (Agilent Technologies, CA) LC

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry was performed on proteins (TRIM46, 480AnkG, and 480AnkG-NN) that were isolated from HEK293T cell lysates via Strep-Tactin affinity purification.
